deadline_contract.client: Helper computes one gate-origin absolute deadline before Popen, reserves its final five seconds for client retirement, never resets it after Popen/proc read/atomic evidence. Every wait uses remaining absolute time; checks after Popen, identity capture, status fsync, direct wait, stream fsync and final evidence.
deadline_contract.construction: Containment gate derives one absolute monotonic deadline as the earliest of the per-client 30-second cap, original containment start+90 seconds, root-sealed monotonic deadline and current conversions of signed UTC and BOOT deadlines. It requires more than five seconds remaining.
deadline_contract.failure: Overrun, unavailable identity, unjoined process, forced kill or uncertain group leaves the sticky client-retirement flag set and reports UNKNOWN; an owner lease is retained. No post-deadline claim of closure or global/native retirement is made.
deadline_contract.watchdog_limitation: Python source cannot bound a blocked Popen, proc read, filesystem fsync, group census or stream read. Source alone is not an actual hard time bound.
